title: Cross-story editorial checks with merge, split and series operations (L)
description:
Cross-story editorial checks, with merge, split and series operations. Smallest first version: the cheap neighbourhood check before publish raising a review request, and merge Proposals with the deterministic merge operation; the daily portfolio review, split and series releases follow.

Two modes:
- A cheap neighbourhood check at chosen transitions (for example before publish); high overlap raises a review request or a Proposal.
- A daily portfolio review across in-flight and recently published stories for duplicates, merge candidates (N->1), split-into-series candidates (1->N, with a release schedule) and coverage gaps.

Results are Proposals of kind merge or split (these kinds exist in PPY-409d96), with the story ids as targets. They hold a group lock (similarity story) while open.

On approval, the merge or split is a deterministic, non-LLM operation. It records lineage (merged_from, series_of, "part n of m") and schedules the series releases.

Acceptance criteria:
- High overlap at the chosen transition raises a review request or Proposal; low overlap does not.
- The portfolio review files merge and split Proposals targeting the right story ids, each holding a group lock until resolved.
- Approving a merge or split performs the operation without an LLM, records lineage and schedules the series releases; rejecting releases the lock.
- Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) required.

Depends on the human review points story and the similarity index story.
